name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-11-04, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
